cases.name: Jennifer Moore
cases.about: She was about to attend and study nursing at the University of Hartford.
cases.narrative: Her body was found in a trash bin in West New York, NJ. He had abducted her from Manhattan, NY. Videotape recovered from the Park Avenue Hotel in Weehawken, NJ showed him leading her through the hotel. where he beat, raped, and strangled her before stuffing her body into a duffel bag. He tried to remove his DNA evidence from her body by cutting her fingernails and cleaning her body with alcohol.
